verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between Skim milk and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, mediated through multiple intermediate targets. Skim milk is linked to Cytochrome c oxidase subunit 6A2, which is targeted by 6-Acetyl-5,8-Dihydroxy-2-Methoxy-7-Methyl-1,4-Naphthoquinone, a compound that in turn targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. Similarly, Skim milk is also linked to Alpha globin, which is targeted by SR-9009, another compound that also targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. These pathways highlight a possible mechanism by which Skim milk may influence the activity of this transporter, though the exact nature of the interaction remains unclear. The evidence suggests a broader role for Skim milk in modulating transporter function, potentially through the action of various compounds, but further investigation is needed to clarify the precise molecular mechanisms involved.
